blocks.text:
## 3 sides of Costa Rica

San José lies among mountains and green valleys. Your journey begins here, with the first night after your arrival.

The next day brings together several of the country’s characteristic sights. At Doka coffee plantation, you will follow the bean’s journey from growing and harvesting to processing and roasting. You will then climb to Poás Volcano National Park, with the temperature and vegetation changing along the way as you pass coffee plantations, flower greenhouses and strawberry farms.

After Poás, the programme continues at La Paz Waterfall Gardens. A trail leads through the forest to the waterfalls, and the grounds are home to hummingbirds, snakes, birds, butterflies and frogs.

Another 2 days are spent around Arenal. Here, tropical forest meets a volcano, a lake, hot springs and traces of past eruptions. The route then reaches the Pacific Ocean for the beach portion of your trip.
